$comment: Azure AI Foundry OpenAPI tool for the Algenta Decision API. Points at the gateway's REDUCED, versioned agent spec (coarse ops only — approval mutation, execution, admin and workspace selection are structurally absent). Validate field names against your Foundry project's current tool schema before registering.
name: algenta_decision_api
description: Coarse governed-decision operations: frame a decision, run the analysis (async), read the result, inspect evidence, propose a plan, record an outcome. Approval and execution are NOT available here — they are separate, credentialed human actions.

auth.$comment: A Foundry service/managed identity token, audience-scoped to the Decision API. The gateway maps the identity to a restricted workspace + app-role; a Graph or ARM token is rejected.
